title: Play log line, version 2
description: One line of user://play_log.jsonl: one answered question or one run event. A superset of version 1 (which had v, t, kind, profile, world, area, level, level_id and the answer or event fields). The server stamps its own arrival time; t is the device clock and may be wrong, boot + mono_ms keep order within a device.

seq.description: +1 per line, per device, never reused. An upload sent twice is harmless.

boot.description: App launches on this device so far.

fights.description: The game's Debug fight switch while this line was written: monster fights asked the step before's math, or the level's own. Optional.

q.description: The question as the child saw it: 3 + 2 = ?

event.description: run_start, run_resume, heart_lost, restart, level_cleared, fight_won, boss_won, app_paused, profile_picked and so on. New names may appear; readers keep lines they do not know.
